newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC to buy Australia's Eyres Reed.
newsitem.headline: CIBC to buy Australia's Eyres Reed.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Thursday that its wholly owned CIBC Wood Gundy Inc brokerage agreed to buy Australian brokerage Eyres Reed Ltd for an undisclosed sum.

Canada's second largest bank said in a statement that the Perth-based Eyres Reed was a full-service brokerage firm specializing in resource company shares, particularly in mining and related industries.
"A strong presence in Australia is crucial to being a global player in mining," said Don Lindsay, managing director of CIBC Wood Gundy's global mining operations.

CIBC said Eyres Reed's activities and staff would be integrated with those of CIBC Wood Gundy's Australian subsidiary. Institutional and investment banking activities in Australia would be carried out under the banner of CIBC Wood Gundy Australia, while the Australian retail broking and the funds management operation would conduct business under the Eyres Reed name.
The deal is subject to regulatory approval.

Eyres Reed is the lead sponsor and chair of Australia's pre-eminent mining investment conference, the annual Diggers and Dealers Forum in Kalgoorlie, which will be held from July 28 to 30 this year, the bank said.
